name: Markaway Stretch Mark Serum 30ml | Herbal Formula for Scars & Skin Elasticity
description:
Markaway Stretch Mark Serum is a powerful herbal blend designed to reduce the appearance of stretch marks, scars, and uneven skin texture. Enriched with aloe vera, rose pulp, rosehip oil, and hyaluronic acid, it deeply hydrates and nourishes the skin, improving elasticity and promoting a smoother, firmer, and more even tone. Safe for pre- and post-pregnancy care, this lightweight, fast-absorbing serum is suitable for daily use.
Key Features
 Reduces the appearance of stretch marks and old scars
 Deeply hydrates and nourishes the skin
 Boosts collagen production and improves skin elasticity
 Enhances overall skin tone and texture
 Safe for pre- and post-pregnancy use
 Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and non-sticky formula
How to Use
 Apply 2–3 drops onto clean, dry skin
 Massage in circular motions until fully absorbed
 Use twice daily, morning and night, for best results
Material
Aloe Vera Extract, Rose Pulp, Glycerol, Vitamin B5, Vitamin B3, Vitamin A Extract, Vitamin E Extract, Hyaluronic Acid, Rosehip Oil, Herbal Extracts, Fragrance, Preservatives
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 30ml Markaway Stretch Mark Serum
